attBesluta.text: I'm a 67 year old woman. I mounted it myself on my 2026 Nissan Kicks. It took me about 1.5hrs to get it all together and centered correctly on top of my car. It's been on my car now about a month with no issues. It's secured and hasn't moved. Next month it will be put to the test on my road trip from Florida to DC. The waterproof bag seems very durable and heavy duty. If all goes well this review will stand as I have faith in the product. I've been using a Vevor Utility Trailer for over a year now hauling all my lawn care gear behind my riding mower. It's stood up to the test wicked nicely. IF there are issues with this roof rack and cargo bag I'll update my review, if not, it will stand as is. Thank you VEVOR for the great products!

Top je recommande. Énormément de place parti à 4 2 adultes et 2 ados pour 1 semaine tout est rentré dedans et le chien n'a jamais eu autant de place dans le coffre de l'avenger. Tient super bien ne bouge pas mm à 130 km/h sur autoroute. Ça a vraiment l'air de la bonne qualité. A voir dans le temps. Je n'ai pas compris les 2 attaché sa l'avant et les 2 attachés à l'arrière, du coup j'ai attaché sur le côté sur les crochets lapereaux prévus à cet effet.
It was affordable and easy to use. Arrived on time, easy to pack and store for next use
Great product design, instructions and value. Well done team Vevor.

Ho acquistato questa borsa da tetto in vista delle vacanze con la famiglia, perché non potendo installare le barre sulla mia auto, questo prodotto si può poggiare direttamente al tetto della macchina e, si è rivelato un ottimo compromesso tra qualità dei materiali, prezzo ma soprattutto per capacità di carico. Consiglio di caricarlo bene e legarlo bene dato l'ingombro e la poca aerodinamicità. Per il resto ottimo prodotto.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Dog Bike Trailer — Sturdy and Easy to Use I’m very pleased with this VEVOR dog bike trailer. The frame feels solid and well built, and the trailer tracks nicely behind the bike. The quick-release wheels and folding design make it easy to set up, take down, and store. There’s plenty of room inside for a larger dog, and I like the 100 lb weight capacity. The universal coupler is straightforward to attach and makes moving the trailer between rides convenient. Overall, a practical, sturdy pet trailer that offers good value for the price. I’d definitely recommend it for anyone wanting to bring their dog along on cycling adventures.

Je l'utilise pour transporter ma chienne de taille moyenne et qui fait 25 kg. Elle a eu des réticences à rentrer dedans au début mais maintenant qu'elle a compris qu'au bout du voyage il y avait sa balle etl a plage, ça se fait tout seul... La remorque est de très bonne qualité, la mettre et l'enlever du vélo se fait en un clin d'oeil, elle est spacieuse (j'ai le grand modèle) et stable et la toile est solide donc pas d'inquiétude meme si ma chienne gratte en voyant la plage s'apporcher;)... Seul bémol la fixation sur le vélo est censée se faire sur le pignon de la roue arrière. Or su mon vélo ce n'est pas du tout aapté la tige du moyeu n'étant pas assez longue. j'ai du fixer la remorque sur un autre écrou de fixation de mon porte vagage. Ca marche mais j'ai quand meme quelques craintes sur la longueur...

La remorque a été facile à monter, j’ai hâte de l’essayer. Le principal problème a été la communication lors de la livraison. L’adresse était incomplète et il fut très compliqué de la modifier. J’ai probablement communiqué avec un robot conversationnel qui avait des réponses toutes faites mais incohérentes.

Ein sehr gutes Angebot! Das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis ist überragend. Lediglich die Schutzkappen für den Heckbereich bei Nutzung von Steckachsen sind minimal zu breit. Mussten etwas/minimal gekürzt werden. Erst danach konnte die Achse korrekt fixiert werden. Der Rest des gesamten Pakets ist sehr gut verarbeitet. Das Gewicht ist ebenfalls nicht zu hoch. Es passt also alles.
Utilizzata per viaggio in aereo Parma-Palermo A/R.....Perfetta! Ho Bici con perno passante e freni a disco. Consigliatissima.
la borsa è perfetta per il trasporto della bici, leggera e scorrevole la consiglio vivamente
Great addition to my home gym. Keeps the plates organized and off the ground. Sturdy and mobile. Highly recommend

Todoo bien, excepto que las barras que lleva de plastico que se ponen sobre lo en travesaños son demasiado gruesas y no permiten colocar los discos, desconozco para que en tipo de discos estan diseñadas, pero desde luego no los normales. Al final he colocado lo en discos en los travesaños.

Quite stable, good quality, excellent product. The pins are 25mm by default, but you receive the converters that make them 50mm. I was a bit worried that for being cheap, the quality would be poor, but I was pleasantly disappointed. I made a good choice buying it. The only negative is that, the given tools are very poor quality. Not a big problem, because I think every man has his own tools at home.

Caricato con 170kg di bumper+2 bilancieri olimpionici,su pavimento irregolare del box: si muove abbastanza facilmente e risulta comunque stabile. Ho molto apprezzato i freni su 2 delle 4 ruote in dotazione. Per ora lo considero un ottimo acquisto!
This is a great budget option for getting a little extra space in my garage gym. It is sturdy enough to keep my bumper plates off the ground and easily accessible.

Works great and can carry a good amount of weight (I have 490lbs of weight plates) and still move around fairly easily. It would be 5 stars, but it came with a loose weight horn and an off center metal weld where the wheels are attached. I would still highly recommend it as it far exceeded my expectations for its price.
